extra.reason: Fixed in a87d742: CARRY_GIVE_UP_TIME is 25 seconds, after which the nest becomes the ground under his feet. Not reproduced on the test-bed, so the log line it writes is how the next report is confirmed. Six waves of Coal Town with it in, five cleared, no crash.
Fixed in a87d742: the refusal is remembered for the trip and the next interval picks the next line down. Upgrade steps a wave unchanged at a median of 17.

Measured: no engineer ever holds two built dispensers. Over four waves with a world scan counting buildings against m_hBuilder, two engineers appeared to hold two each until entities being placed or carried were excluded; then none, over four more waves. What a person sees is the blueprint in his hands while his own dispenser stands at the nest. A ghost line is written for each blueprint or carried building if anybody reports two standing.

Explained and fixed by the break freeze: a rifle sniper is one of the classes ShouldTakeUpPosition refuses, so the stale shopping flag left him with no behaviour for the whole break. Forced into a Decoy lineup afterwards he works: SniperLurk under his stack, 1970 damage and 14 kills over three waves. A fallback that made him fight without a hint was measured and thrown away, 4521 damage lurking against 570 attacking.

The Gas Passer half was already fixed by IsThrowableReady. The residual intermittent watchdog is the path budget, mvm 8fd422e: a symbolised core put the killed frame in CNavArea::GetZ under NavAreaBuildPath with maxPathLength=0, reached from the per-frame path refresh inside PlayerRunCmd, and PATHS_PER_FRAME caps the whole team at two path computations a frame. Since it landed: 41 runs and 231 waves finished with no crash at all. The rates it is measured against are 2 crashes in 9 runs on tf2ap.10 and 4 in 6 on this branch with a Gas Passer. Reopen if one appears; a core is worth taking, see docs/how-bots-break.md.

Fixed in v2.11.0. g_bShoppedThisBreak was cleared on mvm_wave_begin, which ends a break rather than starts one, so every bot that survived a wave carried 'has shopped' through the next break and GetDesiredBotAction had nothing left to offer an engineer or a medic between rounds. A bot that died shopped normally because a spawn clears the same flag, which is why it looked intermittent and why a vote restart froze the whole team. Cleared when the break opens now, on both mvm_wave_complete and mvm_wave_failed. Measured on Decoy, AUTO_BOTS, two waves cleared either way: share of between-wave samples with no behaviour, engineers 86% and 100% before, 0% and 0% after; medic 100% to 76%, and the medic's own share closed separately. The between-waves table in the run report is the instrument.
